corpus.text: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Tanzania and the tallest freestanding mountain in the world, rising 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) above sea level. Located in northeastern Tanzania near the border with Kenya, Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcanic massif comprising three distinct volcanic cones. Its snow-capped peak has become an iconic symbol of Africa.

corpus.text: Phobos is the largest moon of Mars, measuring approximately 27 by 22 by 18 kilometers across. Discovered by Asaph Hall in 1877, Phobos orbits extremely close to Mars at just 6,000 kilometers above the surface. The moon is gradually spiraling inward toward Mars and is predicted to either crash into the planet or break apart to form a ring system within 50 million years.
corpus.title: Mars largest moon reference

corpus.text: George Orwell is the author of 1984, a dystopian novel published in 1949 that depicts a totalitarian society under the omnipresent surveillance of Big Brother. The novel introduced concepts and terminology such as doublethink, thoughtcrime, and Newspeak that have become part of common English usage. Orwell wrote the book as a warning about the dangers of totalitarianism and the manipulation of truth.
corpus.title: 1984 author reference

corpus.text: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain, situated in the center of the Iberian Peninsula. The city became the permanent capital in 1561 during the reign of Philip II and has served as the political, economic, and cultural center of Spain ever since. Madrid is known for its rich cultural heritage, including the Prado Museum and the Royal Palace.

corpus.text: Ganymede is the largest moon of Jupiter and the largest moon in the entire Solar System, with a diameter of 5,268 kilometers, making it even larger than the planet Mercury. Discovered by Galileo Galilei in 1610, Ganymede is one of the four Galilean moons. It is the only moon known to have its own magnetic field and is believed to have a subsurface ocean of liquid water.
corpus.title: Jupiter largest moon reference

corpus.text: Mexico is located in North America, forming the southern portion of the continent and connecting to Central America. It is bordered by the United States to the north and Guatemala and Belize to the south. Mexico is the third-largest country in Latin America and has the largest population of any Spanish-speaking country in the world.

corpus.text: Titan is the largest moon of Saturn and the second-largest moon in the Solar System after Jupiter's Ganymede. With a diameter of 5,150 kilometers, Titan is larger than the planet Mercury. It is the only moon in the Solar System with a dense atmosphere, primarily composed of nitrogen, and is the only celestial body besides Earth known to have stable surface liquids in the form of methane and ethane lakes.
corpus.title: Saturn largest moon reference

corpus.text: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France, situated on the river Seine in the north-central part of the country. The city has been a major center of finance, diplomacy, commerce, fashion, science, and the arts for centuries. Paris is home to landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, and Notre-Dame Cathedral.

corpus.text: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper, derived from the Latin word cuprum, which in turn comes from the Greek Kyprios, referring to the island of Cyprus. It has been used by humans for over 10,000 years and was one of the first metals to be smelted from ore.
